description: Verify an existing FreshProof Proof Receipt without making a new network request. This free tool checks deterministic receipt integrity and optionally evaluates trust policy rules. Use it when you already have a proof_id from observe_url or verify_url and want to re-check evidence without paying for another observation. The result includes valid, decision (PASS, FAIL, or UNKNOWN), per-rule checks, and the stored receipt.

policy.description: Optional declarative trust policy. All supplied rules must pass for decision PASS; any failed rule yields FAIL. UNKNOWN is reserved for cases where FreshProof cannot make a reliable policy decision.

changed_since_content_hash.description: Prior SHA-256 response-body fingerprint. Passes when the current proof has a different content hash.

content_hash_equals.description: Expected SHA-256 response-body fingerprint, including the sha256: prefix. Passes only on exact equality.

final_host_equals.description: Expected lowercase hostname after redirects, for example example.com. Provide a hostname, not a full URL.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum allowed age of the stored observation in seconds at verification time.

original_host_equals.description: Expected lowercase hostname from the originally requested URL. Provide a hostname, not a full URL.

require_same_origin_redirect.description: When true, fails if the final URL origin differs from the original URL origin after redirects.

status_in.description: Allowed HTTP status codes. The rule passes when the observed status is in this list.

proof_id.description: FreshProof proof identifier returned by observe_url or verify_url.

name: verify_proof

actual.description: Observed value used by the rule.

expected.description: Expected value or condition used by the rule.

decision.description: Overall policy decision. PASS means every supplied rule passed; FAIL means at least one supplied rule failed; UNKNOWN means a reliable decision could not be made.

proof_id.description: FreshProof proof identifier returned by observe_url or verify_url.
FreshProof proof identifier returned by observe_url or verify_url.

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 content address of the canonical Proof Receipt payload.

valid.description: True when the stored receipt passes deterministic integrity verification.
